title: FloodGuard Companion Credit on CondoGuard Coverage A Realignment
content:
Rating supplement of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy for the rate used when Coverage A is realigned to the tier's minimum.

**Rule.** The flood companion multiplier on the realignment rate is 0.93 when the customer holds an in-force FloodGuard policy written on a condominium unit whose first inception date is 36 or more whole months before the day of the realignment, 0.97 when the customer holds such an in-force FloodGuard condominium-unit policy with a first inception date fewer than 36 whole months before that day, and 1.00 when the customer holds no in-force FloodGuard policy written on a condominium unit. The multiplier is applied to the tier's Coverage A rate per 1,000 USD, before the full-year realignment charge is rounded. Where that rate carries more than one multiplier, they are first multiplied together and then applied once to the tier's rate; none of them acts on the result of another.

**Records read.** The customer's FloodGuard Private Flood Policy: whether it is in force, whether its occupancy shows a condominium unit, and its first inception date (the first coverage start), counted in whole months to the day of the realignment.

| In-force FloodGuard Private Flood Policy on a condominium unit | Whole months since its first inception | Flood companion multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 36 or more | 0.93 |
| yes | fewer than 36 | 0.97 |
| no | not measured | 1.00, no flood companion adjustment |

## Illustrations (hypothetical customers)

- FloodGuard condominium-unit policy in force, first incepted 36 whole months before the realignment: 0.93; 35 whole months: 0.97.
- A FloodGuard policy in force on a single-family house, and none on a condominium unit: 1.00.
- A FloodGuard condominium-unit policy that has been cancelled: not in force, 1.00.
- With a tier rate of 3.29 USD and 0.93 as the only multiplier on it, the rate becomes 3.29 multiplied by 0.93, 3.0597 USD per 1,000 USD, carried unrounded into the full-year charge.
